evidence.quote: economic conditions are likely to warrant exceptionally low levels of the federal funds rate for an extended period
substantial resource slack is likely to dampen cost pressures, and the Committee expects that inflation will remain subdued for some time.
Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in June suggests that economic activity is leveling out.
the Committee has decided to gradually slow the pace of these transactions and anticipates that the full amount will be purchased by the end of October.
The Committee will maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent

parsed.rationale: The statement keeps rates near zero with extended-period guidance, describes inflation as subdued, and continues large asset purchases, so the stance is clearly accommodative. A modest hawkish tilt comes from the improving activity assessment and the decision to taper the Treasury purchases, which keeps the overall score short of maximally dovish.
